_comment: Editorial content for BFMOD. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. A modaraba is a listed Islamic financing vehicle, so products is left empty rather than filled with guessed 'products'.
description: B. F. Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle rather than an operating company — managed by E. A. Management (Private) Limited. Established in 1989 within the Amin Bawany Group, it provides Shariah-compliant financing through leasing, murabaha and musharaka, alongside equity-market and investment operations, trading and services. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: 43-1-E(B), Block 6, P.E.C.H.S., off Razi Road, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Modaraba website (bfmodaraba.com.pk: about, contact) and its PSX listing, read 2026-10-17. No chief executive is named on the pages read, so ceo is left empty.
